filters.name: Parametrization: Voronoi Atlas
filters.shortDescription: Build an atlased parametrization using a geodesic Voronoi partition of the surface.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Build an atlased parametrization based on a geodesic voronoi partitioning of the surface and parametrizing each region using Harmonic Mapping. For the parametrization of the disk like voronoi regions the used method is:
Ulrich Pinkall, Konrad Polthier
Computing Discrete Minimal Surfaces and Their Conjugates
Experimental Mathematics, Vol 2 (1), 1993.

parameters.label: Approx. Region Num
parameters.help: An estimation of the number of regions that must be generated. Smaller regions could lead to parametrizations with smaller distortion.

parameters.label: Overlap
parameters.help: If checked the resulting parametrization will be composed by overlapping regions, e.g. the resulting mesh will have duplicated faces: each region will have a ring of ovelapping duplicate faces that will ensure that border regions will be parametrized in the atlas twice. This is quite useful for building mipmap robust atlases.

filters.name: Convert PerWedge UV into PerVertex UV
filters.shortDescription: Convert per-wedge texture coordinates into per-vertex texture coordinates, splitting vertices when needed.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Converts per Wedge Texture Coordinates to per Vertex Texture Coordinates splitting vertices with not coherent Wedge coordinates.

filters.name: Convert PerVertex UV into PerWedge UV
filters.shortDescription: Convert per-vertex texture coordinates into per-wedge texture coordinates.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Converts per Vertex Texture Coordinates to per Wedge Texture Coordinates. It does not merge superfluous vertices...

parameters.label: Projection plane
parameters.help: Choose the projection plane.

parameters.label: Preserve Ratio
parameters.help: If checked the resulting parametrization will preserve the original apsect ratio of the model otherwise it will fill up the whole 0..1 uv space.

parameters.label: Side Gutter
parameters.help: Leave an empty space around the parametrization area of the specified size (in texture space); accepted range [0.0 - 0.5].

filters.name: Parametrization: Trivial Per-Triangle
filters.shortDescription: Generate a triangle-by-triangle parametrization using either equal-size or space-optimizing layout.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Builds a trivial triangle-by-triangle parametrization.
Two methods are provided, the first maps all triangles into equal sized triangles, while the second one adapt the size of the triangles in texture space to their original size.

parameters.label: Quads per line
parameters.help:
Indicates how many triangles have to be put on each line (every quad contains two triangles)
Leave 0 for automatic calculation.

parameters.label: Texture Dimension (px)
parameters.help: Gives an indication on how big the texture is.

parameters.label: Inter-Triangle border (px)
parameters.help: Specifies how many pixels to be left between triangles in parametrization domain.

parameters.label: Method
parameters.help: Choose space optimizing to map smaller faces into smaller triangles in parametrizazion domain.

filters.name: Set Texture
filters.shortDescription: Associate an existing image file with the current mesh texture coordinates.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Set a texture associated with current mesh parametrization.
If the texture provided exists, then it will be simply associated to the current mesh; else the filter will fail with no further actions. If specified it can create and associate a dummy texture with a specified grid or checkboard pattern.

parameters.label: Texture file
parameters.help: Sets the given input image as unique texture of the mesh.

parameters.label: Use dummy texture
parameters.help: If checked, the filter will set a dummy texture instead of loading an image. The 'Texture file' parameter will be ignored.

parameters.label: Dummy size
parameters.help: Size in pixel of the square dummy texture.

parameters.label: Check size
parameters.help: Size in pixel of the checkerboard or grid cell of the dummy texture.

parameters.label: Dummy Texture Type
parameters.help: Choose what kind of dummy texture you want, a grid with lines or a checkboard.

filters.name: Transfer: Vertex Color to Texture
filters.shortDescription: Bake per-vertex color into texture image(s) using the current UV parametrization.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Fills the specified texture using per-vertex color data of the mesh.

parameters.label: Texture file
parameters.help: Base path of the texture image to be created. If more than one texture slot is used, numeric suffixes are added automatically.

parameters.label: Texture width (px)
parameters.help: The texture width.

parameters.label: Texture height (px)
parameters.help: The texture height.

parameters.label: Overwrite texture
parameters.help: If current mesh has associated textures, overwrite them instead of creating new files.

parameters.label: Fill texture
parameters.help: If enabled the unmapped texture space is colored using a pull-push filling algorithm, otherwise it is left black.

filters.name: Transfer: Texture to Vertex Color
filters.shortDescription: Generate vertex colors by sampling texture colors from the same mesh or another mesh.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Generates Vertex Color values picking color from a texture (same mesh or another mesh).

parameters.label: Source Mesh
parameters.help: The mesh with associated texture that we want to sample from.

parameters.label: Target Mesh
parameters.help: The mesh whose vertex color will be filled according to source mesh texture.

parameters.label: Max Dist Search
parameters.help: Sample points for which we do not find anything within this distance are rejected and not considered for recovering color.

parameters.label: Source Texture
parameters.help: Choose which associated source texture to sample. Automatic uses the source mesh per-face texture slot assignment.

filters.name: Transfer: Vertex Attributes to Texture
filters.shortDescription: Transfer texture color, vertex color, normals, or quality from one mesh into another mesh texture.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Transfer texture color, vertex color or normal from one mesh the texture of another mesh. This may be useful to restore detail lost in simplification, or resample a texture in a different parametrization.

parameters.label: Source Mesh
parameters.help: The mesh that contains the source data that we want to transfer.

parameters.label: Target Mesh
parameters.help: The mesh whose texture will be filled according to source mesh data.

parameters.label: Color Data Source
parameters.help: Choose what attribute has to be transferred onto the target texture. You can choose between per-vertex attributes or transfer color information from source mesh texture.

parameters.label: Max Dist Search
parameters.help: Sample points for which we do not find anything within this distance are rejected and not considered for recovering data.

parameters.label: Texture file
parameters.help: Base path of the texture image to be created. If more than one target texture slot is used, numeric suffixes are added automatically.

parameters.label: Texture width (px)
parameters.help: The texture width.

parameters.label: Texture height (px)
parameters.help: The texture height.

parameters.label: Overwrite Target Mesh Texture
parameters.help: If target mesh has associated textures, overwrite them instead of creating new files.

parameters.label: Fill texture
parameters.help: If enabled the unmapped texture space is colored using a pull-push filling algorithm, otherwise it is left black.

parameters.label: Source Texture
parameters.help: When Texture Color is selected, choose which associated source texture to sample. Automatic uses the source mesh per-face texture slot assignment.
